summary: Plan Mode (Cursor) maps to Planning Mode (ODD epistemic modes) - no execution until explicit permission to move to Execution Mode
impact: Prevents epistemic mode violations. When in Plan Mode, agent is epistemically in Planning Mode and must not execute changes. Execution requires explicit permission to transition to Execution Mode.

summary: smart-build.js evidence path bug: script looked for /attempts/<lane>/... but evidence lives at /products/<lane>/attempts/...
impact: Build failures when evidence exists but script cannot find it. Fixed by updating lines 139-141 in infra/smart-build.js to use lane-contained paths.

summary: Cloudflare preview URL pattern is <branch-slug>.klappy-dev-website.pages.dev, not <branch-slug>.klappy-dev.pages.dev
impact: Incorrect preview URLs cause confusion. Project name is 'klappy-dev-website' not 'klappy-dev'. Branch slugs get truncated (e.g., run/odd-teaser/prd-v1.0/cursor/a/claude-opus-4/402940ce becomes run-odd-teaser-prd-v1-0-curs).

summary: E0003.1 evidence requirements: need either 1 recording OR 3 screenshots minimum before build succeeds when .attempt.json exists
impact: Build will fail if .attempt.json exists but insufficient evidence is captured. Screenshots must be captured before build can succeed.

summary: Lane self-containment: all attempt artifacts live under products/<lane>/attempts/prd-vX.Y/_runs/<run_id>/. Root /attempts/ is legacy.
impact: Looking for evidence in wrong location causes build failures. Lane-contained paths are the canonical structure per E0003.

summary: Build output location: lane builds output to products/<lane>/dist/, not root /dist/
impact: Expecting build output in wrong location causes deployment confusion. Each lane has its own dist/ directory.
